definitions: Fundamental rights inherent to all human beings, regardless of race, sex, nationality, ethnicity, language, religion, or any other status.
Basic rights and freedoms to which all individuals are entitled, often considered universal and inalienable.
examples: The protection of human rights is a global concern.
Activists are fighting for human rights in many countries.
A declaration on human rights was adopted.
Violations of human rights must be addressed.
